If flights are changed, a single gift card or credit card already in the user profile must be provided. gift_card_3112961 is in the profile (h6), so this condition is met, but the action is still prohibited by q10.

regulated_action.description: Call modify_pending_order_items to swap item 9190635437 for 5320792178 on pending order #W9300146, using gift_card_7245904 for the price difference.

applicable_norms.interpretation: Before any database update (modify), list action details and obtain explicit user confirmation (yes).
At most one tool call per turn; a tool call turn must not also send a user message.
Modify pending order only if status is 'pending'; check status before acting.
Each item may be modified to an available new item of the same product but different option; no product-type change.
User must provide a payment method for the price difference; if a gift card is used, it must have enough balance to cover the price difference.
Modify items can be called only once per order; collect all items to change before the single call.

supporting_evidence.fact: Order #W9300146 status is 'pending'; current item 9190635437 (Desk Lamp, $153.23); original payment gift_card_7245904.

User explicitly confirmed: 'Yes, that all sounds correct. Please go ahead and make the change.'

The single-call and all-items-collected conditions are met because only one item is being modified and it was confirmed.

All applicable policy conditions are satisfied; no violation is established.
